text.text: The port registers Nether cobalt ore generation. Mine it with a suitable pickaxe to obtain raw cobalt; Silk Touch preserves the ore instead. Natural generation and harvesting have not been verified in a running world.
Once obtained, raw cobalt or cobalt ore can be processed in a vanilla blast furnace: one input produces one cobalt ingot. This existing route does not require a Melter, Smeltery or Foundry.
